questions.prompt: In Domain-Driven Design, an aggregate is a cluster of domain objects treated as a unit for data changes.
questions.explanation: An aggregate defines a consistency boundary; changes are coordinated through its aggregate root.

questions.prompt: What does a bounded context define in DDD?

options.text: A boundary within which a particular domain model and its terms apply
A database index shared by every service

questions.explanation: A bounded context establishes where a specific model and its ubiquitous language are valid.
